user.title: Recteq Grill
user.description: Enter the name and communication parameters for your Recteq grill. See the README of this repository for assistance figuring out these values.

error.invalid_host: The Host is invalid. Please enter a valid '#.#.#.#' IPv4 address.
error.invalid_device_id: The Device ID is invalid. It must be exactly 22 characters. If copied from the Tuya app, it may contain hidden characters - paste it into a plain text editor first.
error.invalid_local_key: The Local Key is invalid. It must be exactly 16 characters. If copied from the Tuya app, it may contain hidden characters - paste it into a plain text editor first.
error.invalid_protocol: The Protocol is invalid. Please enter 3.1, 3.3, or 3.4.
